issues.description: Default speaker mismatch between docs/config and TTSModelConfig for bulbul:v3-beta
issues.detail: PR description and class docstring state the v3-beta default speaker is 'aditya', but TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh'. This contradicts the stated invariant 'v3 default = aditya'. A reader auditing the table against the code will conclude the configuration is wrong. Pick one and align both.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 speakers for unknown models
issues.detail: The function returns v2 speakers for any unrecognized model name with no warning. This violates 'fail loudly' for an invariant the rest of the module enforces (model must be in TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS). Either raise ValueError or return an empty list; silently returning v2 speakers will mislead callers validating v3+ speakers.

issues.description: Boolean fields typed as bool but default to None
issues.detail: InputParams.vad_signals and high_vad_sensitivity are annotated `bool` but defaulted to `None`. Pydantic will accept this, but the type contract is wrong; a reader cannot tell whether None means 'unset' or 'False'. Use `Optional[bool] = None` to state the tri-state explicitly.

issues.description: Automatic pace clamping for v3 is silent and undocumented at call site
issues.detail: The PR description says pace is auto-clamped when outside v3 range (0.5-2.0). Silent clamping is a correctness hazard: a caller asking for pace=3.0 on v3 will get 2.0 with no signal. At minimum log a warning at clamp time and state the invariant in the docstring of the setter so the next reader does not assume linear pass-through.

issues.description: MODEL_CONFIGS table is the load-bearing invariant; it deserves a literate comment
issues.detail: The Dict[str, ModelConfig] table is now the single source of truth for prompt/mode/language/endpoint dispatch, replacing scattered string-matching on 'saaras'/'saarika'. Good refactor, but the table has no header comment naming this invariant ('to add a model, add one row here; no other code change required'). One block comment would make the abstraction obvious to the next reader.

issues.description: input_audio_codec dropped from connect_kwargs without justification in the diff
issues.detail: The old _connect passed 'input_audio_codec' in connect_kwargs; the new version removes it unconditionally. If the SDK still accepts/requires it for some endpoints (e.g., non-wav inputs), this is a silent behavior change. Either document why it was removed for all models, or restore it conditionally per ModelConfig.

review.summary: The refactor from string-matching on model substrings to a typed ModelConfig table is the right move — it makes the dispatch invariant explicit and centralizes the rules. The STT side is largely RIGOROUS once the config table is in place. The TTS side is NEEDS-LITERATE-COMMENT and has one clear inconsistency: the v3-beta default speaker is documented as 'aditya' but coded as 'shubh', and get_speakers_for_model swallows unknown models. Silent pace clamping and the dropped input_audio_codec are smaller correctness questions worth resolving before merge.
